description.narrative: The project will contribute to (i) reduce travel time and congestion ii) enhance safety for drivers and pedestrians, and (iii) avoid GHG emissions. The Project introduces an innovative instrument that contributes to unlock the sustainable debt financing market for subnational infrastructure in Argentina, and promotes resilience. IFC is supporting Cordoba through advisory services to develop a Sustainability-Linked Financing Framework aligned with international standards. It is helping define KPIs and SPTs tied to the Provinces goals on gender-based violence and emissions. The Province is expected to increase coverage of its network of support services (Punto Mujer) to prevent and reduce gender-based violence.

The proposed investment is a sustainability-linked senior loan of up to USD 200 million to Provincia de Cordoba (the Province or Cordoba) to finance the expansion of National Route (RN) 8 and RN A005. These roads will serve as critical bypass routes for Rio Cuarto, the second-largest city in the Province (the Project).
